vignettes.prompt_zh: 这个点的鞋长和回归线差多少？换算成 Mondopoint 是几号？
vignettes.prompt_en: How far is shoe length from the girl OLS line? What Mondopoint does it map to?

vignettes.prompt_zh: 同样身高，男童回归线给出的鞋长和女童线差几毫米？
vignettes.prompt_en: At the same height, how many millimetres do the two sex-specific lines differ?

vignettes.prompt_zh: 高身高端点还在散点带里吗，还是已经靠近上沿？
vignettes.prompt_en: Is the tall end still inside the main cloud, or hugging the upper edge?

vignettes.prompt_zh: 矮身高端用厘米鞋长说话，还是不小心读成零售欧码？
vignettes.prompt_en: At the short end, is the y-value still centimetres of length — not a retail EU mark?

vignettes.title_zh: 相对身高脚更长的女童
vignettes.title_en: Girl with a long positive residual
vignettes.prompt_zh: 正残差 1cm 大约是半个巴黎点还是一个童鞋 UK 码？
vignettes.prompt_en: Is a +1 cm residual closer to half a Paris point or a full UK kids size?

vignettes.title_zh: 相对身高脚更短的男童
vignettes.title_en: Boy with a short negative residual
vignettes.prompt_zh: 负残差时，放余量还要不要按 12mm 一刀切？
vignettes.prompt_en: With a negative residual, should the 12 mm allowance still be applied blindly?

vignettes.title_en: Girl near the longest shoe values
vignettes.prompt_zh: 最大值标注和回归线，哪一个更不该直接拿去买鞋？
vignettes.prompt_en: Which is less safe to shop from: the max marker or the regression line?

vignettes.title_en: Boy near the shortest shoe values
vignettes.prompt_zh: 短鞋长点换成中国号后，还会不会被误读成成年 10 号？
vignettes.prompt_en: After converting to a Chinese length number, could someone still misread it as an adult size 10?
